description: This file defines a custom exception class 'InvalidHeaderValueException' used in the MMS library, extending the 'MmsException' class. It provides constructors for creating instances with or without a detailed message.

classes.name: InvalidHeaderValueException
classes.description: A checked exception indicating an invalid header value was encountered, used in MMS message processing.

methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the exception without a message.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a custom message.
